analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. 금일 RSI 35.0으로 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 히스토그램은 -192.1026으로 악화 지속. 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 71,505원으로 동일하나, 5일 고가(80,295원)가 20일 고가(97,285원) 대비 하락하며 하락 채널을 형성 중. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 0.76으로 위축되어 방향성 확인에 어려움. 주봉 RSI 34.2로 약세 구간이나, 주봉 SMA100(68,657원) 대비 6.24% 상회하며 지지 가능성도 존재. ADX 29.3으로 뚜렷한 추세는 형성되었으나, -DI(36.6)가 +DI(19.4)보다 높아 하락 우위. 현재가 72,945원은 스윙 지지선 72,060원에 근접. 변동성 ATR 4,524원 대비 손절폭 1.3배(5,881원) 설정 시 손절가는 67,064원, 목표가는 2.6배(11,762원) 설정 시 84,707원. 손익비 2.0으로 양호하나, MACD 악화 및 하락 채널 형성으로 매수 진입은 부적절. 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see stance for the past 3 sessions. Today, RSI at 35.0 entered oversold territory, and MACD histogram worsened to -192.1026. The 5-day low matches the 20-day low at 71,505, but the 5-day high (80,295) is lower than the 20-day high (97,285), forming a downtrend channel. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.76 times the 5-day average, hindering directional confirmation. Weekly RSI at 34.2 indicates weakness, but it remains above the weekly SMA100 (68,657) by 6.24%, suggesting potential support. ADX at 29.3 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (36.6) is higher than +DI (19.4), showing downside bias. Current price of 72,945 is near the swing support of 72,060. With ATR at 4,524, a 1.3x ATR stop loss (5,881) would be at 67,064, and a 2.6x ATR target (11,762) would be at 84,707, yielding a favorable 2.0 risk-reward ratio. However, due to MACD deterioration and the downtrend channel, a buy entry is not advisable. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

· MACD histogram trajectory (-113.4659 → -192.1026): worsening, reinforcing the bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 70,463 KRW): approaching the lower band, with support expected.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.76x): reduced reliability of price movement, making directional confirmation difficult.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): unsuitable for buy entry due to MACD worsening and downtrend channel formation; maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
